num_facilities: <int> Number of candidate facility locations that may be opened.
num_customers: <int> Number of customers that must each be served by exactly one open facility.
demands: <list[int], length num_customers> Quantity of goods or service required by each customer.
capacities: <list[int], length num_facilities> Maximum total demand that each facility can handle if opened.
fixed_costs_obj1: <list[int], length num_facilities> Fixed cost incurred for opening each facility under the first cost structure.
fixed_costs_obj2: <list[int], length num_facilities> Fixed cost incurred for opening each facility under the second cost structure.
assignment_costs_obj1: <list[list[int]], shape [num_facilities][num_customers]> Cost of assigning each customer to each facility under the first cost structure.
assignment_costs_obj2: <list[list[int]], shape [num_facilities][num_customers]> Cost of assigning each customer to each facility under the second cost structure.
